title: Gold Rate Today, Aug 14: Check latest Gold prices in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Chennai Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Gold prices down in India | Photo Credit: MUSTAFAH KK

Gold prices in India fell today across all cities. The price for 8 grams of 24-carat gold also decreased in all cities compared to yesterday. Below is a detailed breakdown of gold prices in key cities.

Gold prices in India today were ₹14,065 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹180) and ₹1,12,520 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹1,440).

22 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,065 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹180) and ₹1,12,520 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹1,440).

24 Carat: The gold prices in Mumbai today were ₹14,768 for 1 gram of 24-carat gold (down by ₹189) and ₹1,18,144 for 8 grams of 24-carat gold (down by ₹1,512).
